notes.title: Round 5 of Additional DLC Available Now!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that starting today, additional downloadable content (DLC) adding new characters and interactions for the action RPG "FAIRY TAIL 2" are available!

New Party Members: Mavis and Zeref
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193180/FAIRY_TAIL2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193190/FAIRY_TAIL2/
The new party members, "Mavis" and "Zeref" are now available to download*. Mavis, the first master of the "Fairy Tail" guild, also known as the "Fairy Tactician", and the Black Wizard Zeref have been added as playable team members! Outside of battle and exploration, you can enjoy new character stories unlocked through “Magic Origin Growth” along with special outfits “Luxury Restaurant,” “Happy Wedding,” and “Fairy School.”

*Note: These characters are already included in the Season Pass. Please avoid making redundant purchases.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/5c22ecd4f970c59e4674189d875fe4ab72542459.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/0d9515346ba89eef25df190e1d7c379e3a8d21ce.jpg

Various updates also live!
In the paid DLC feature "Arena" you can challenge team battles like the "The Dragon King Festival," where you face all members of the "Spriggan 12," as well as Zeref and Acnologia. Additionally, in the free update, new Exchange Quests have been added featuring characters like "Sting", "Rogue", "Ichiya", and "Sherria". Enjoy game-original scenarios and events, such as visiting a haunted house with Frosch and Rogue, or assisting in Sherria's "Magic Class to Learn the Truth of 'Love'."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/414bf0f1d33b8718c522cf53b6dc86d73c19d088.jpg
Furthermore, as part of the free update, a fourth Origin Core and Tree have been added to the Magic Origins. Once you fully develop all three Origins, you can further enhance your characters' strength. Additionally, the highest difficulty level "FIRED UP!" surpassing "RAGNAROK" has been added, so be sure to "fire up" your passion and take on the challenge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/77d74491f679d5883e848a84968d55cce2b0410b.jpg

notes.title: Round 3 of Additional DLC Available Now!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that starting today, the third round of additional downloadable content (DLC) for the action RPG "FAIRY TAIL 2" , is available!

Bonus Feature: “Arena”

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193210/FAIRY_TAIL2/

In the bonus feature: “Arena”, also included in the season pass, you can take on the strongest enemies from the game once again in “Rematch Mode”. The “Arena” DLC also introduces “Trial Mode”, enabling you to battle against team combinations fans of the anime always dreamed of, which can only be challenged in this game. For example, the combination known as “Calamity and Despair” , is made up of the most powerful wizard king “August” and the Scarlet Despair  “Irene” from the Spriggan 12. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/af0a7164881f1adfe6a9931fa251dab161319c0e.jpg

Victory in the “Arena” rewards players with event scenes of the participating characters celebrating while also adding the ability to repeatedly challenge the new modes to improve clear times!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/66ec63c4236571476377f0e2886e492b257f22d2.jpg

Bonus Quest: “Encounter Quests”

A free update has also been added giving four characters -- “Jellal”, “Lyon”, “Kagura”, and “Makarov” -- additional “Encounter Quests”. 

Enjoy fighting dark guilds alongside Jellal or visit places important to Zeref and Mavis in original events only viewable in “Fairy Tail 2”!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/547438d9c2ac96ce676f8aa429e60a8cd25b26db.jpg

notes.title: FIGHT THE ALVAREZ EMPIRE IN KOEI TECMO’S EPIC RPG FAIRY TAIL 2, NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/35a1e8fedc260450aafc64bf09a5c90abb328b88.jpg

This new RPG depicts the "Alvarez Empire Arc," the climactic final arc of the original series. We have revamped the in-game systems and graphics from the previous installment, offering more spectacular and exhilarating real-time magical battles and expansive fields that players can explore seamlessly. Additionally, players can enjoy character interactions unique to this game along with, after completing the main story, an entirely original game story titled "The Key to the Unknown" unfolding over four extensive chapters!

Launch trailer also unveiled!
In celebration, we have also unveiled the launch trailer for this title.
[previewyoutube=4Z6Bh76XocY;full][/previewyoutube]

More details about the upcoming DLC!
The first will be released on December 23rd, 2024 featuring the “Special Outfit: Complete Set” and “Erza Outfit: ‘Miss FAIRY TAIL Contest’” among others. Additionally, from January onwards, we plan to release the “Bonus Scenario: ‘FAIRY TAIL Hot Springs’” along with other items such as the “Outfit Set: ‘Swimsuit’”.

A Season Pass is also available to purchase and will include a bonus scenario that pays homage to the “Battle of FAIRY TAIL” where guild members battle to see who is the strongest. The Season Pass also includes an arena where you can re-challenge bosses, more playable characters, alternative costumes for Erza and Wendy, and more.

notes.title: Introducing details about support characters!
notes.content:
In the battles of this title, members of Fairy Tail guild such as Cana and Levy, as well as characters from outside the guild like Jellal, Sting, and Rogue, can join the fight as support characters. By meeting certain conditions during combat, they can help by healing allies or attacking enemies. Additionally, as battles heat up, you can use "Extreme Magic", which significantly impacts both allies and enemies.

notes.title: New information on the game-original story out now!
notes.content:
After clearing all 12 chapters of the main game, a completely original storyline, “Key to the Unknown”, will unfold, opening new areas that could not be reached in the main game.

From heartwarming to comical themes, all four of its large-volume chapters depict various stories including the procurement of a hidden gem in a restaurant located in a forest somewhere in the west, participating in an event to determine the midsummer champion at “Akane Beach” in the south, and encounters with unexpected characters. Feast your eyes on immersive and memorable places from the anime and manga, as well as a variety of game-original locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/8ff14ef5087d30eae7f2eb233952ecfe246b99db.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/8e4a5f52d13c1e4c95f59b346657df894b2a3f30.png

Photo Mode and other rich features!
We have included the ability to take photos at various points in your journey through the “Photo Mode” feature. Take pictures in memorable locations and line up your favourite characters however you like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/f76ad055fdcb29ca3906bb8b55407ecedb81092a.png

Furthermore, we have added the ability to look back at the final “Alvarez Empire” arc from the original series through various in-game features and events, which can help those who have not played the previous “FAIRY TAIL” game, or are not familiar with the series to fully enjoy this title.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/b1b91d750ed37bda2f03d414711e6e62b6073009.png

notes.title: FAIRY TAIL 2’S FINAL BATTLE WILL BEGIN ON 11TH DECEMBER, 2024
notes.content:
Today, KOEI TECMO and developer Gust are happy to announce that FAIRY TAIL 2, their new action RPG based on the popular franchise FAIRY TAIL, will be released on 11th December, 2024.

First trailer now live!

[previewyoutube=TnrG9AnM8Rg;full][/previewyoutube]


The newly unveiled trailer gives players a first look at the heroic and speedy magic battles Natsu and the team must unleash in order to defeat their greatest enemy, Zeref, the Emperor Spriggan of the Alvarez Empire. The battles have been completely revamped to reflect the exciting action during combat, and fans will be given the opportunity to use the full scope of the FAIRY TAIL guild members' skills to triumph over their opponents.

In addition to the standard edition, fans can now pre-order the “FAIRY TAIL 2 GUILD BOX” edition, which includes the base game, the visual artbook “Sorcerer Magazine Special Issue: Game Release Edition Vol.2” inspired by the “Sorcerer Magazine” as seen in the original work, a Special Shikishi with Holographic Finish (3 types in total), and more. 
*Only available in Europe. See official website for details. 

Fans will also be able to digitally pre-order at a later date the “FAIRY TAIL 2 Digital Deluxe Edition” which will include additional in-game content such as costumes, characters, scenarios, various DLC to enhance the game experience, and more at a later date. More information will be shared soon.

Stay tuned for the latest on FAIRY TAIL 2!
